title: Knowledge Distillation and Dataset Distillation of Large Language Models: Emerging Trends, Challenges, and Future Directions
core_idea: Provide a comprehensive survey of knowledge distillation (KD) and dataset distillation (DD) methods for compressing large language models, detailing key techniques (e.g., task-specific alignment, rationale-based training, multi-teacher frameworks; optimization-based gradient matching, latent space regularization, generative synthesis), exploring their integration, and identifying challenges and application areas for efficient deployment.
tldr: A focused survey that analyzes KD and DD approaches for compressing LLMs, examines how combining these paradigms can improve scalability and deployment, and highlights methodological directions and practical challenges.
